text:
The plate is a white paper plate, probably about 18-20 cm across. It holds about 13 almonds, which look like whole, unshelled kernels.

A single almond weighs roughly 1.2 g, so 13 almonds come to about 16 g. Almonds have about 6 kcal per gram, so that is roughly 95 kcal.

The kernels look fairly large, about 2 cm long, so I'll use 1.3 g each. That gives 13 × 1.3 ≈ 17 g, or about 100 kcal.

{"kcal": 100, "mass_g": 17}
